lifecycle.scope: Installed work-order checks used by the browser sample. Not the public host.

funds.note: Covenant never holds customer funds. Name a rail only when fund_holder is set on that payment method.

standards.name: MCP 2025-11-25
standards.what: The tool connection the public server speaks. It can draft and check. It cannot sign, publish, pay or refund.
standards.where: Public host /mcp. Send MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-11-25.
standards.date_note: Specification date. The public server speaks this version, read-only for payment.

standards.name: MCP 2026-07-28
standards.what: A later MCP specification. This host does not speak it.
standards.where: Exercised in the server sandbox in test. The public host still speaks 2025-11-25.
standards.date_note: Specification date. server/discover is offered in the server sandbox in test.

standards.name: MCP auth (RFC 9728)
standards.what: OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata. A client uses it to find how to ask for a token.
standards.where: Exercised in the server sandbox in test. Not published on the public host. The public MCP needs no token.
standards.date_note: RFC 9728 is dated April 2025. The RFC text does not give a day.

standards.name: MCP Server Card
standards.what: A static description of a remote MCP server, found from an AI catalog.
standards.where: Prepared copy on this docs site at /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json. The API host path /mcp/server-card is not activated.
standards.date_note: SEP-2127 created 21 January 2026. The extension repository still describes the card format as experimental.

standards.name: A2A v1.0
standards.what: A way for agents to give each other tasks. An agent card would live at /.well-known/agent-card.json.
standards.where: Installed demo named on the agent start page. Not the public host. This site does not publish /.well-known/agent-card.json.
standards.date_note: v1.0.0 published 12 March 2026.

standards.name: Agent card
standards.what: The A2A description a client reads from /.well-known/agent-card.json.
standards.where: The server sandbox serves this in test. This docs site does not publish the file.
standards.date_note: A2A v1.0.0 published 12 March 2026.

standards.name: AP2 v0.2
standards.what: Checkout Mandate and Payment Mandate, each open or closed. IntentMandate and CartMandate are previous names from v0.1.
standards.where: The server sandbox checks mandates in test. Those checks do not charge a card and are not Live.
standards.date_note: v0.2.0 in the changelog. v0.1 was announced on 16 September 2025. Current terms are also on https://ap2-protocol.org/.

standards.name: a2a-x402
standards.what: An A2A extension that carries an x402 payment between agents.
standards.where: Not named as an installed check. The x402 row below is a separate local test ledger.
standards.date_note: Spec version v0.2. The spec page does not print a publication date. Checked 4 November 2026.

standards.name: x402 v2 exact
standards.what: A fixed-price HTTP 402 payment. The buyer authorises the advertised amount.
standards.where: Installed package has a local test ledger and payment-evidence checks. A matching message is not an external facilitator and does not move real funds.
standards.date_note: Protocol version 2 is stated in the x402 specification. This scheme page does not print a publication date. Checked 4 November 2026.

standards.name: Partial capture
standards.what: Taking only the finished part of a held test payment.
standards.where: Server sandbox only. This browser sample does not split a hold.
standards.date_note: Described with x402 auth-capture. The dedicated scheme URL returned 404 on 4 November 2026.

standards.name: x402 v2 auth-capture
standards.what: A refundable x402 payment: deposit, then capture, void or refund.
standards.where: The server sandbox runs auth-capture in test, including a partial capture. Release and refund move test money there. Reclaim stays planned.
standards.date_note: The schemes overview describes auth-capture. It does not print a publication date. Checked 4 November 2026.

standards.name: ACP 2026-04-17
standards.what: OpenAI and Stripe’s Agentic Commerce Protocol for agent checkout. The business stays the merchant.
standards.where: Not connected on this host.
standards.date_note: Changelog version 2026-04-17.

standards.name: Stripe Shared Payment Tokens
standards.what: A scoped grant an agent can give a seller for one payment method, without showing the card number.
standards.where: Card is coming soon and not connected. An owner-run Stripe gateway in the installed package is not this host.
standards.date_note: SharedPaymentGrantedToken API changelog. Stripe’s SPT blog post is dated 7 October 2025.

standards.name: UCP 2026-08-25
standards.what: Universal Commerce Protocol. A common checkout language for agents and businesses.
standards.where: Not connected on this host.
standards.date_note: Release v2026-08-25, published 25 August 2026.

standards.name: Web Bot Auth
standards.what: A signed directory a site publishes so others can check that a bot’s request is genuine.
standards.where: This site does not publish /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory.
standards.date_note: Cloudflare documentation dated 8 October 2026. It cites IETF drafts, not a finished RFC.

standards.name: Visa TAP
standards.what: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol. A merchant checks an agent’s signed request.
standards.where: Installed package can check supported request-signature profiles. Those checks do not charge a card or settle on Visa.
standards.date_note: Repository checked 4 November 2026. A newsroom page dated 14 October 2025 in search results returned 404, so that announcement date is not confirmed from a page that still resolves.

standards.name: Mastercard Agent Pay
standards.what: Mastercard’s agent payment programme, including registered agents and network tokens.
standards.where: Same installed request-signature checks as Visa TAP. They do not settle on Mastercard.
standards.date_note: Product page returned HTTP 403 to this review on 4 November 2026. No announcement date was confirmed from a page this review could read.

standards.name: KYAPay
standards.what: An identity-linked token a service can check before accepting an agent.
standards.where: Not in the installed checks described on the payments page.
standards.date_note: Whitepaper dated 26 June 2025.

standards.name: Release
standards.what: Sending a held payment to the seller.
standards.where: Moves test money in the server sandbox. Not real funds, and not Live.
standards.date_note: Listed in sandbox.works_in_test. Not a live payment.

standards.name: Refund
standards.what: Sending a captured or held test payment back to the buyer.
standards.where: Moves test money in the server sandbox. Not real funds, and not Live.
standards.date_note: Listed in sandbox.works_in_test. Not a live payment.

standards.name: Reclaim
standards.what: What is left comes back after the capture deadline.
standards.where: Not confirmed by the server. TODO(owner): the number of days.
standards.date_note: Kept planned until the server registry confirms it. Checked 4 November 2026.
